bpmn:signal.name: External notification failure owner alert requested

bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-24 | External Notification Dispatch and Retry

bpmn:process.name: External Notification Dispatch and Retry
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md, all 43 scopes and reuse rules; capstone SRS 4.17 FR-NOTIF-01?07,11?15; NFR-PERF-05, NFR-AVL-02, NFR-SAF-04?05. Reviewed index.html and linked app/notification-state.js, app/notifications.js and app/staff-state.js: prototype exposes event/recipient linkage, per-channel sending status and transaction independence, but does not implement real provider dispatch or retry scheduling. Proposed SRS governs this design. Existing docs BPMN XML conventions and reuse references reviewed; broad inventory/checkout diagrams are not invoked. BPMN-25 handles internal owner alert creation asynchronously; Each instance handles one applicable recipient/channel; originating event fan-out supplies independent instances as needed, so successful channels are not resent. One initial send and three automatic retries use delays after the preceding failure, not a repeating 5-minute timer. Non-executable descriptive BPMN; nextRetryAt is a conceptual date expression, not engine-specific code. Service task captures normal results and service failure outcomes; a missing provider response is handled by the integration as a failed attempt without inventing an SRS timeout duration. Vertical responsibility lanes and a black-box provider pool. Provider interactions are sending outcomes, not customer read receipts.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Supported external notification event
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Confirmation (BPMN-10), applicable order/delivery status changes (BPMN-13?21), upcoming subscription fulfillment or other supported notification-relevant events trigger dispatch independently. One instance per applicable recipient/channel; both channels create independent instances.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Resolve recipient, applicable channel and provider; initialize run log
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-NOTIF-01?07,11?14. Determine applicable customer recipient/context from source record. Email uses Brevo; SMS uses Semaphore. Record notification type, provider, recipient, source activity and sending status. Automatic retries completed r=0. Initiate first provider request within the 5-second event target (NFR-PERF-05).

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Send email via Brevo or SMS via Semaphore
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Invoke only the provider chosen for this channel; log attempt identity. Return the provider sending outcome or capture provider error/unavailability as a failed attempt. A successful sending status is not proof of recipient reading. Provider delivery latency is external. Request and result message flows cross the provider pool; no sequence flow leaves Kitchen406.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Log attempt outcome and sending status
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Retain provider outcome/error, attempt time, retry information, recipient context, type and related activity. Preserve independent channel statuses. Exclude secrets from diagnostic logs (NFR-SAF-05).

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Three automatic retries completed?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Initial send plus at most three automatic retries. A failed retry increments r before this check.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Select next delay: 5, 15 or 30 minutes
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: If r=0 choose PT5M; if r=1 choose PT15M; if r=2 choose PT30M. Set nextRetryAt = preceding failed attempt time + chosen interval. Do not measure intervals from the original event.

bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent.name: Wait until next retry is due
bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent.bpmn:documentation: FR-NOTIF-13: cumulative earliest attempts at 0, 5, 20 and 50 minutes if sending and processing are immediate. Use the absolute due date based on each preceding failure; processing time does not extend the required interval.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Increment automatic retry count; retry failed channel
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Increment r once for the scheduled attempt and return to the same provider dispatch step. Do not resend channels already Sent.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Mark notification Failed; preserve attempt history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Failure status and owner alert from FR-NOTIF-15. All three retries have failed. Retain failure details. Never roll back the originating purchase, reservation or fulfillment (NFR-AVL-02, NFR-SAF-04).

bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.name: Refer to BPMN-25 ? Internal Notification Creation and Read Acknowledgment
bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.bpmn:documentation: Asynchronously request a role-targeted Admin/Owner alert linked to the failed notification. BPMN-25 owns internal notification creation and per-account read state; do not wait for reading or send a recursive external failure alert. No bounded BPMN-25 XML exists yet, so use a signal handoff rather than an unresolved calledElement.

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: Yes
bpmn:sequenceFlow.bpmn:conditionExpression: r = 3 and the latest attempt failed.

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: No
bpmn:sequenceFlow.bpmn:conditionExpression: r < 3 and the latest attempt failed.
